dct_description_sm: This dataset contains video and audio recordings produced in Dhofar between 2023 and 2025. The recordings relate to Mehri descriptions of winds, clouds, bodies of water, phases of the moon and paths. They are accompanied by ELAN files with transcriptions, translations and annotations for communicative gesture. The transcriptions, translations and annotations were produced by Janet Watson in collaboration with Sulaiman al-Mahri. To access the ELAN files, you need to download the freely accessible ELAN for Linguistics software.

Five of the files recorded from 202301 to 202401 are presented and annotated in the chapter Water, Clouds and Wind among the Mahrah. The 2023 files contributed to the short film, The language of wind, produced by Rosa Prosser with Janet C.E. Watson, which was screened at the Open City Documentary Festival April 2024: https://vimeo.com/862350250/4a5f62e934
dct_title_s: Winds, clouds, water, paths and phases of the moon in Mehri
